recoverable_workflow_errors: Two initial process launches selected a staging directory before it existed. No commands executed in those calls. Staging was created and the launches retried.

One local layout-edit attempt used a workspace-relative path while its working directory was the traditional source directory. The edit did not run. It was applied using the absolute path and the subsequent build used the corrected source.
Initial page-enlargement adjustment did not retain the proof-ending square. Local display spacing outside the proof subsequently kept it with the final equation.
An initial unbreakable replay command created an overfull line. Separate command paragraphs removed both the discretionary path hyphen and overflow.
render_failures_resolved: Raw commutative-diagram tokens replaced with the same nodes/arrows in a stable array
Orphan QED and isolated proposition clause kept with their statements
Corollary kept together around the final full-page figure
Lean headings and declaration metadata kept together
Replay commands kept unbroken within the text margin
limitations: Computational results are bounded to their documented finite/numerical suites.
This pass preserves proofs and proofreads prose. It is not a new global proof audit.
